$Comment: Old Jack buys back a spare Eternal Candle. One is all a player needs to open the Headless Horseman's graveyard without a Grave Candle, and the Horseman's Hoard can drop more, so this turns a second one into Hallow Sweets. The player hands in one Eternal Candle (Cost.Items, taken from the bag, storage or hotbar like any item price on this shop) and gets the sweets in Rewards, a Currency row paid straight into their Hallow Sweets wallet; change Amount to change what he pays. Icon shows the candle on the shelf rather than the wallet's own picture. No purchase limit and no rotation. SortOrder 9 puts it after the candle offers on the lanterns shelf and before the Jack Lantern. A player holding only one can still sell it, so the title and flavor call it a spare.
